# What’s New in TimeVault 1.0.3
- The dashboard now distinguishes an idle backup from having no backup drive connected. - When no compatible backup drive is mounted, Add backup drive becomes the primary action and Browse snapshots is hidden. - View local snapshots is disabled when no local snapshots are available or discovery cannot confirm any. - Local snapshot browsing remains available independently when local snapshots exist, even if the external backup drive is disconnected.
